text.tspan: Proxies use host networking / Workloads keep separate ns
Workload B: separate private network namespace
Each app and its TCP adapters share one ns. Ghostunnel stays outside it.
Unix sockets cross ns boundaries through declared mounts and group permissions.
Unix groups control local socket access. allow.groups expands to SPIFFE identity allowlists.
Solid links: request paths. Dashed links: identity control.
Containers use their own ns and mounted sockets instead of joining realm-net-<name>.
Unix ingress socket for TCP backend
Gateways with their own mutual TLS
Local SPIRE Agent on each host
Issues identity by systemd unit + Unix user
Loopback TCP or declared Unix socket
